answer: An artifact in the context of AI agents is a file written down by AI [1], [2]. Specifically, passages describe these files as “Markdown files that it writes in a folder in your computer” [2]. These files, often named “memory.md,” store context, project details, or plans created by the AI [2]. For example, a presentation plan created by an AI is considered an artifact [3].
